capabilities: Track initiative, HP and AC for players and creatures in a right-pane combat view
Run encounters with next/previous combatant controls, status effects and re-rolls
Create encounters in notes using an "encounter" code block with name, players and creature parameters
Manage players and customize the initiative formula in settings
Trigger combat controls through commands such as Toggle Encounter and Next Combatant
extras: The README links to a trimmed-down fork of an unnamed initiative tracker plugin (the link text is stripped). It warns that bugs may delete data and recommends automated backups, and notes that custom condition rendering is still being improved. Conditions are populated dynamically from notes tagged #condition.
intentEvidence: a trimmed-down fork of which aims to separate out the iniative concepts from the DnD 5e
motivation: The author forked an existing tracker to separate initiative concepts from D&D 5e specifics and make it system-agnostic.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track turn order, HP, AC and status effects for combatants during tabletop RPG sessions.

relations.evidence: This setting can only be modified when the Dice Roller plugin is installed.

summary: System-agnostic initiative tracker for tabletop RPG combat that adds a sidebar view to run encounters built from notes with players and creatures.
